title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Code
description: Copilot Code is a new AI-powered coding experience in Microsoft Copilot that helps people turn ideas into working software, starting from the work they already do and building through natural language, grounded in their work by Work IQ. Projects can be published as managed apps on Copilot Managed Runtime with IT in control, and can optionally extend when connected to GitHub repositories and pull requests for review and further development.
